name: Iron Summit
summary: Iron Summit is a rugged prominence rising northeast of Blackrock Mountain in the scorched expanse of Searing Gorge. In this era, the elevated outcrop remains an uninhabited landmark overlooking the volcanic wastes and the industrious sprawl of the Dark Iron dwarves below.

sections.title: A Lonely Ridge in the Wastes
sections.body: Rising northeast of the monolithic Blackrock Mountain, the rocky heights of the Iron Summit look out over the smoldering expanse of Searing Gorge. Unlike the bustling excavation operations at the Slag Pit or the secretive outposts maintained by rival factions, the summit itself stands quiet and unsettled in the current era. It remains a stark geological landmark within a harsh, ash-choked wilderness dominated by territorial beasts and the sprawling machinations of the Dark Iron clan.

faq.answer: The Iron Summit is a natural, elevated mountain ridge situated northeast of Blackrock Mountain within Searing Gorge. In the present era, it is simply a geographical landmark overlooking the volcanic terrain and dark dwarf excavations below.

faq.q: Is there a settlement or camp on the Iron Summit?
aliases: is there a camp at iron summit
faq.answer: No. Currently, the heights of the summit have no established town, outpost, or permanent camp. The barren rocky prominence remains largely undisturbed while active mining and military operations take place elsewhere in the gorge.

The surrounding territory of Searing Gorge is firmly dominated by the Dark Iron clan. Although the summit itself hosts no garrison, the entire region falls under the shadow and influence of Shadowforge City and Blackrock Mountain.

angles.text: The craggy ridges throughout Searing Gorge are notoriously rich in dark ores and mineral veins, making high outcroppings like Iron Summit prominent vantage points for prospectors mapping the terrain.
